What official Commission/AI Office implementing instruments for GPAI providers had been published as of 2026-07-19, and what are their legal status and relevant dates? Does the Article 53(2) exemption apply if the open-source model is offered as part of a paid or commercial service?

Cover high-impact capabilities, the presumption based on cumulative training compute above 10^25 FLOPs, Commission designation ex officio or following a qualified alert from the scientific panel, the Annex XIII criteria, and the Commission's power to amend thresholds by delegated acts.
What dissenting or minority opinions, if any, were noted within the IARC Working Group regarding the Group 2B classification?
Does any official EU Commission or Parliament source confirm that no amendment was proposed to the Chapter V (GPAI) compliance deadline of 2 August 2025 in the Digital Omnibus on AI?

TfL/GLA 2025 One Year Report의 'ULEZ impact analysis' 섹션(본문 69페이지 부근)에서 outer London NO2·PM2.5 농도 변화를 어떻게 수치로 보고했는가?

What is the institutional relationship and division of roles between IARC and JECFA within the WHO/FAO system? Were the 2023 evaluations of aspartame coordinated, and in what sequence and on what dates were they conducted and announced?

How does it assess genotoxic carcinogens (e.g., the margin of exposure approach)?

Have any studies used synthetic control or synthetic difference-in-differences, for example with other UK cities or non-ULEZ areas as donor pools, to estimate the effect of the 2023 ULEZ expansion on air quality or traffic? What estimates and placebo- or permutation-based uncertainty did they report?

How much of each change was attributed to the scheme versus background trends?

How do WHO and IARC describe the hazard-versus-risk distinction in public communication materials (Q&As, press releases, and explainers on red and processed meat in 2015, glyphosate, radiofrequency electromagnetic fields, aspartame, etc.)? What analogies or explanations do they use, and what consumer guidance do they give?
What transitional deadlines (e.g., 2 Aug 2025 vs 2 Aug 2027) apply to the Article 54 authorised representative requirement depending on when the GPAI model was placed on the market?

Do the AI Act's general provisions that have applied since 2 February 2025, namely Article 4 (AI literacy) and Article 5 (prohibited practices), also impose obligations on providers of general-purpose AI models? If so, what is the official legal basis or interpretation?

Between the end of 2024 and July 2026, what ULEZ compliance rates did TfL report for vehicles observed in the expanded outer London area, and how did they compare with the pre-expansion baseline (e.g., early or mid-2023)? Do not re-collect the already-confirmed figure of 96.7% at September 2024.
What specific mechanistic evidence (key characteristics of carcinogens) did the IARC Working Group cite as 'limited' for aspartame, per the Lancet Oncology summary or Volume 134 Monograph text?
JECFA의 96차 회의 결과 보고서 원문에서 ADI 유지 여부와 구체적 수치가 어떻게 기술되어 있는가?

Elasticsearch의 kNN pre-filtering 메커니즘은 구체적으로 어떻게 동작하며 pgvector의 post-filtering과 어떻게 다른가?

Elasticsearch의 네이티브 샤딩(shard/replica) 아키텍처는 수평 확장을 어떻게 구현하는가?

Compare PostgreSQL 17 and Elasticsearch 8.x for hybrid lexical and vector search, including native capabilities, consistency, ranking controls, and operational trade-offs. Prefer official documentation and primary sources.

What liability or penalty consequences arise under the AI Act if a non-EU GPAI provider fails to appoint an authorised representative?

Has the EU AI Office or Commission issued official guidance defining 'genuine free and open-source licence' for purposes of Article 53(2)?
AI Act 제3조의 'AI 시스템' 정의와 'GPAI 모델' 정의가 법적으로 어떻게 구분되는지 (제4조·제5조 해석의 전제가 되는 정의 조항)

제113조(발효 및 적용일)의 제V장 적용일 규정과 제111조 제3항의 경과 규정은 조문상 어떻게 연결되는가? 제111조 제3항이 제113조의 일반 적용일에 대한 명시적 예외로 기능하는가?
EUR-Lex 또는 EU 관보(OJ L, 2024/1689, 2024.7.12)에 실린 EU AI Act 제111조 제3항의 공식 원문은 정확히 어떤 문구로 되어 있으며, '2 August 2027'이라는 날짜가 조문에 명시되어 있는가?
free-threaded 빌드의 메모리 사용량은 기본(GIL) 빌드에 비해 얼마나 늘어나는가? mimalloc 할당자, 지연 참조 카운팅(deferred reference counting), QSBR 기반 지연 해제 같은 구조적 원인과 3.13·3.14 벤치마크 수치를 함께 비교하라.
As of 2026-07-19, which EU AI Act obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models are already applicable, and on what dates did they begin to apply? Use official EU sources.

What did JECFA conclude in its 2023 re-evaluation of aspartame (96th meeting)? Did it change the acceptable daily intake (ADI) of 0–40 mg/kg body weight, and on what evidence and reasoning? Use the JECFA meeting summary or report and the joint WHO/FAO statement.

On what specific date did the Commission publish/adopt the Guidelines on the scope of the obligations for providers of GPAI models, and what is their formal legal instrument type (e.g., Commission notice/communication)?
How does JECFA's methodology explicitly incorporate exposure level and dose-response relationships when deriving an Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI), according to JECFA/WHO official documents?

According to Article 113 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) as published in the Official Journal (EUR-Lex), when did the Act enter into force, and from what date do the Chapter V provisions on general-purpose AI models (Articles 51-56) and related governance and penalty provisions apply?

What ranking control do Elasticsearch's function_score and script_score queries provide? Cover decay functions, field_value_factor, Painless scripts, and vector similarity functions such as cosineSimilarity and dotProduct inside script_score. How can they be used to hand-build hybrid lexical plus vector scoring, and what are their version availability and license tier?
How do custom ranking functions in PostgreSQL (e.g. via plpgsql or SQL expressions) compare to Elasticsearch's script_score for ranking control?

Examples include the Digital Omnibus on AI proposal (COM(2025) 836) or another implementing or amending act. If so, what is its legal status and effective date?

WHO는 공동 보도자료, Q&A, 기자회견(예: Francesco Branca 영양·식품안전국장 발언)에서 아스파탐을 단정적으로 'carcinogenic'이라고 표현했는가? 아니면 'possibly carcinogenic' 등 유보적 표현과 hazard 대 risk의 구분을 사용했는가? 실제로 쓰인 문구는 무엇인가?

EUR-Lex의 CELEX 기반 TFEU 통합본(consolidated text) URL에서 Article 113 조문을 직접 확인할 수 있는가?

What are the operational trade-offs between the two systems? Cover horizontal scaling and sharding (PostgreSQL extensions such as Citus versus native Elasticsearch sharding), memory requirements for HNSW graphs, index build time and maintenance (VACUUM, maintenance_work_mem, segment merging), backup and upgrades, the availability of managed services, licensing (PostgreSQL License, Elastic License/SSPL/AGPL), and the architectural cost of running a separate search cluster versus consolidating on one database.

Through July 2026, how many non-compliant vehicles did TfL detect daily or uniquely in the expanded ULEZ area (by vehicle type, such as cars and vans), how did these numbers change from the pre-expansion baseline, and what were the related penalty charge notice (PCN) volumes?

What confounders and methodological limitations threaten causal attribution of post-2023 air quality and traffic changes to the ULEZ expansion? Examples include meteorology, post-COVID traffic recovery, national fleet turnover and Euro standard trends, pre-existing downward trends, and monitoring-site selection. Where and why do official estimates differ from independent or academic estimates, including lessons from evaluations of the 2019 central and 2021 inner ULEZ phases?

How do consistency and durability semantics differ between the two systems? What are the implications of each model for keeping a search index in sync with the source of truth?
